payload.claim: The only production call to `render_pr_body` (the one that writes `pr_body.md` and is pushed as the actual PR body) never passes `notes=outcome.notes`. `render_pr_body`'s new `notes` parameter defaults to `""`, so this call silently renders every real task's PR body with no notes section, even when `outcome.notes` was populated, extracted, hashed and written to `notes.json` by `_drive_cell`. Acceptance criterion 1 ('An implementer's notes reach the pull request body...') is therefore never satisfied for any task run through the normal pipeline — only `tests/test_report.py`, which calls `render_pr_body` directly with an explicit `notes=` argument, exercises the rendering; nothing exercises `package.py`'s own call site with a non-empty `outcome.notes`, so gates and the suite cannot see the missing wire.
